mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last 3 months signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when the GDP growth is negative, or if the correlation between GDP growth and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production by more than 2% within the last two months signals a strong supply-side response, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the CPI is increasing by more than 0.3% per month, the combined effect of high interest rates and inflationary pressure reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.3% in 1 month
regime_hint: high inflation and tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when both trigger conditions are met, or if the joint effect of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL on negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 300,000 in a month and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2%, the combined signal of strong labor market and reduced unemployment boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 300,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both trigger conditions are met, or if the joint effect of increasing PAYEMS and decreasing UNRATE on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts by more than 10% within the last two months signals a strong demand for housing, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between HOUST increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures by more than 1% over two consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when RSAFS growth is positive, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
